title: Sign law for Ramanujan's third order mock theta function $ρ(q)$
summary: We study the coefficients of Ramanujan's third order mock theta function \[ ρ(q)=\sum_{m\geq 0} \frac{q^{2m(m+1)}}{(1+q+q^2)(1+q^3+q^6)\cdots(1+q^{2m+1}+q^{4m+2})} =\sum_{n\geq 0}r(n)q^n. \] Numerical evidence suggests the striking sign pattern \[ r(3n)>0,\qquad r(3n+1)\leq 0,\qquad r(3n+2)\leq 0. \] We prove an asymptotic form of this phenomenon.
